svg.title: All 22 made-up leads through the tested code (npm run replay)
svg.desc: Terminal output of npm run replay: one line per made-up lead with the rule, owner or queue, tier, score, Clay status, AI label and review flag, then the writes to HubSpot and Slack.
svg.text: All 22 made-up leads through the tested code
Output of npm run replay. The same code runs inside the n8n workflow; 95 tests check it lead by lead.
